item.title: Oklahoma (SB 1488): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: SB 1488 — proposed statewide moratorium on new data centers until Nov 2029; in committee

item.title: Oklahoma City: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Emergency moratorium through end of 2026 on zoning and development applications for data centers, unanimous. Exempts 75 MW and below after a later amendment, plus two pending rezonings
